title: Grateful Dead Live at Ice Palace on 1969-03-29
source: Fix for Charlie Miller source, patched with 4th-gen cassette.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a free, downloadable ’69 Dark Star
ai_review.review: The single‑track recording is praised for its pristine soundboard quality and the sheer joy of hearing a 1969 Dark Star at no cost. Reviewers highlight the performance as unbeatable, suggesting both the musical moment and the audio fidelity are top‑notch.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one five‑star review; it lauds both the soundboard source and the Dark Star performance, indicating a very high rating but limited data for confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Free downloadable SBD praised as crisp and flawless; no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not discussed beyond the highlighted Dark Star performance.
